jobs.occupation: Operations Manager | Technical Expertise Meets Leadership
jobs.description:
Lead mission-critical operations where cloud meets on-prem infrastructure—drive reliability, inspire teams, and shape the future of digital services.

Our client is a well-established technology organization operating and supporting large-scale, business-critical digital platforms.

 

The company manages a complex hybrid infrastructure environment combiningcloudandon-premises technologies, with a strong focus on operational excellence and continuous innovation.

 
Operations Manager - Tasks & Responsibilities
• Lead the day-to-day operations of Infrastructure, Operations, and Internal IT teams, ensuringservice continuity,operational excellence, and delivery of key initiatives.
• Coordinateincident management, problem resolution, escalations, and service improvement activities across production environments.
• Drive the evolution of infrastructure platforms, includingLinux systems, virtualization, containers, automation, and observability solutions.
• Manage team priorities, workloads, and stakeholder expectations while fosteringaccountability,collaboration, and continuous improvement.
• Ensure operational compliance withsecurity standards, governance requirements, and infrastructure best practices.
Operations Manager - Profile
• Minimum5 years of experiencein Infrastructure Operations, IT Operations, System Engineering, or a similar technical leadership role.
• Proven experience inteam management, people leadership, coaching, and operational coordination within complex environments.
• Strong background inLinux-based infrastructures, networking, virtualization, cloud and/or on-premises environments.
• Experience withincident management, service delivery, operational governance, and continuous improvement methodologies.
• Excellentcommunication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with fluent English.

We are looking for a Network Engineer with a strong focus on Azure Cloud to help design, evolve, and operate our customers hybrid network infrastructures. You will play a key role in integrating on-premises environments with Azure in a secure, scalable, and highly available way.

In this role, you combine deep networking expertise with strong knowledge of Azure networking services, working closely with Cloud, Security, and Architecture teams. You take ownership of complex network topics and help shape a modern, cloud-ready and future-proof infrastructure.

Your days will consist of automating and maintaining the systems of our customers, as well as optimize our infrastructure and align cloud systems to serve our business goals. You’ll use your expertise in cloud platforms, automation frameworks, containerization, virtualization, networking, and security practices to drive digital transformation.

Our goal is to build reliable and cost-efficient systems. As a Network Engineer, you’ll make it happen by designing, implementing, and supporting scalable cloud environments.

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent
• At least 4 years of experience as a Network Engineer
• Proven experience of Cloud networking in hybrid network architectures (Azure, AWS)
• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and Cloud architecture principles.
• Experience implementing, monitoring and troubleshooting Azure building blocks (ExpressRoute, VPN gateways, Azure DNS,…).
• Implement and maintain network security solutions, including firewalls, network segmentation and Zero-Trust environments.
• Practice of Automation tools is an asset.
• Fluent in English, French and Dutch
Preferred Qualifications

• Relevant professional certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Network Engineer, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, CCNA/CCNP.
• Experience with DevOps practices and tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Ansible, Terraform, ARM templates).
• 
Clear written and oral communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders

jobs.occupation: Digital Marketing Manager (M/W/D) B2B / Life Science Division (Kaufmann/-frau - Marketingkommunikation)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Digital Marketing Manager

Stellenbeschreibung:
Your Future at 3CON

The 3CON Group is an internationally successful hidden champion in plant engineering and special-purpose machinery. For many years, we have been developing high-end solutions for the automotive industry, the life sciences sector, and other demanding industries.

We are 3CON — bold pioneers, dependable problem-solvers, and a family-run global player. With over 800 employees worldwide across Austria, Germany, the USA, Mexico, and China, we shape industrial manufacturing at the highest level.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed and creative individual to join us as a:
Digital Marketing Manager (m/f/d) — B2B / Life Sciences

Your Responsibilities:

● Planning, optimizing, and analyzing performance campaigns (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads), along with ongoing SEO optimization of our new WordPress website.

● Structured qualification and handover of marketing leads to our sales teams.

● Creating white papers, technical articles, case studies, and web content tailored to decision-makers in the pharma and biopharma sectors.

● End-to-end organization of major international trade fairs (e.g. CPHI, Interphex), including compliance with all booth-construction and logistics requirements.

● Strategic development and editorial planning of our social media activities.

● Monitoring campaign and event budgets.

Your Profile:

● Experienced in international B2B marketing, combined with a solid technical understanding of the pharma, biopharma, life sciences sector.

● Sound knowledge of LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, SEO, and analytics tools.

● Fluent, business-level English (written and spoken) is essential — it is our primary working language.

● Very good German (written and spoken) is also required for day-to-day collaboration.

● A structured way of working and strong execution skills when meeting complex deadlines.

● Hands-on experience with WordPress and CRM systems is an advantage.

● Basic graphic design skills for independently creating social media posts and smaller marketing materials are desirable.

● Experience organizing international trade fair appearances.

What We Offer:

● Challenging tasks in an international environment with flexible working-time models.

● State-of-the-art workplaces designed to the latest ergonomic standards.

● Individual development paths through a wide range of internal and external training opportunities.

● The opportunity for assignments abroad at our plants (Mexico, China, USA), including special bonuses.

● An in-house 3CON Health Center with a company doctor, sports offerings, and subsidized therapeutic massages (50% covered).

● An excellent company restaurant serving freshly prepared, regional dishes at preferential prices.

● A genuine team spirit fostered through regular sports, team-building, and social events.

● Exclusive employee benefits (including bike leasing and discounts with partner companies such as Hagebau and the Inntal Logistics Park).

Rewards That Pay Off:

● Compensation is based on the collective agreement for the metal industry. As we set high standards for top performance, we are expressly willing to pay significantly above this baseline — your actual salary will be agreed individually, based on your qualifications and professional experience.

Have we sparked your interest? Then we‘d love to get to know you.
